name: Password Pusher (Legacy)
tagline: Give your users the tools to be secure by default.
description: Password Pusher is an open source application to communicate passwords over the web. Links to passwords expire after a certain number of views and/or time has passed.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Mariadb password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Mariadb random root password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-pwpush application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-pwpush
  # The `big-bear-pwpush` service definition
  big-bear-pwpush:
    # Name of the container (Docker does not have to generate a random name)
    container_name: big-bear-pwpush
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: pglombardo/pwpush:1.69.3@sha256:7bf7f919b87d818a9cafa2a5c53e2565a577a7b90983b3cd55de90d6de71cf07
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables for the container
    environment:
      # Database connection string
      DATABASE_URL: mysql2://pwpusher:${SECRET_MARIADB_PASSWORD}@big-bear-pwpush-db:3306/passwordpusher_db
      # Password expiration settings
      PWP__PW__EXPIRE_AFTER_DAYS_DEFAULT: "1"
      PWP__PW__EXPIRE_AFTER_VIEWS_MIN: "1"
      PWP__PW__RETRIEVAL_STEP_DEFAULT: "true"
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Storage volume
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage:/opt/PasswordPusher/storage:rw
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 5100 of the host to port 5100 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:5100"
    networks:
      - big_bear_pwpush_network
  big-bear-pwpush-db:
    container_name: big-bear-pwpush-db
    image: mariadb:10.6.5@sha256:ca31f38b6e325ece985d857db7eba1fe59928b4fd83ff8a55cb912c9684b9e43
    ports:
      - "3306:3306"
    environment:
      MARIADB_USER: "pwpusher"
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MARIADB_PASSWORD}
      MARIADB_DATABASE: "passwordpusher_db"
      MARIADB_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MARIADB_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
    networks:
      - big_bear_pwpush_network
networks:
  big_bear_pwpush_network:
    driver: bridge
